questions.prompt: Which city is the decision centred on?
questions.why_it_matters: Property evidence and risks are local.
questions.expert_context: This sets the market context; the eventual decision must still be verified at project and property level.

questions.prompt: What job must this property perform?
questions.why_it_matters: A good home and a good investment are not always the same property.
questions.expert_context: I will keep lifestyle value separate from financial return and show where they conflict.

questions.prompt: What is your all-in purchase ceiling, including taxes and transaction costs?
questions.why_it_matters: Affordability must include acquisition friction, not only the advertised price.
questions.expert_context: I will treat this as a hard ceiling unless your financing answer shows a genuinely comfortable buffer.

questions.prompt: What approximate usable size do you need?
questions.why_it_matters: Usable area converts market rates into an investable all-in estimate.
questions.expert_context: I will not compare localities using a price-per-square-foot number detached from the space you need.

questions.prompt: How long can you realistically hold the property?
questions.why_it_matters: Transaction costs and illiquidity punish short holding periods.
questions.expert_context: A short horizon makes flexibility and resale liquidity more valuable than an optimistic appreciation story.

questions.prompt: How stretched would the purchase leave your household?
questions.why_it_matters: A property that removes the household safety buffer is not affordable merely because a lender approves it.
questions.expert_context: This is a potential veto: resilience to income, rate and repair shocks matters before upside.

questions.why_it_matters: Localities express different combinations of use value and financial characteristics.
questions.expert_context: I will make the chosen priority visible in the ranking rather than assuming appreciation is always the goal.

questions.prompt: How much execution, climate and resale uncertainty can you accept?
questions.why_it_matters: Infrastructure promises and site risks can dominate headline affordability.
questions.expert_context: Lower tolerance will favour verified, liquid corridors over speculative upside.
